selectionAuthority: vendor/t3code/source-manifest.json packages[].scope and files[].action; supplemental outputs and every inputs[] tuple in mcp-skills-adaptations.json
replayAuthority: Existing integration-patches exact original-line splice JSON and supplemental exact-line-splices/local-bytes recipes only. No second patch stack.
generation: Author only in the core-owned isolated candidate, from immutable Git objects and reviewed merged outputs. Advance the production pin and all production-linked derivation references together; retain the independent supplemental snapshot pin. Never recapture drift or run upstream/candidate code.
reauthoring: An already recorded maintenance generation may be reauthored at the same pin. Every changed source/output requires its exact current SHA256 approval; guarded sources also require reasoned acceptance, and derived changes require all mapped input identities. Metadata/recipe edits, host inputs, OMP, deletions and mode changes cannot be enrolled through this path. Preserve original generation ancestry and legacy helper guards.
initialLocalAuthoring: The first record of a local-authoring candidate requires core-authenticated isolated prepare intent: purpose=local-authoring, initialLocalAuthoring=true, reauthorGeneration=true, all pin identities unchanged, no source changes or source-scope approvals, and exact current hashes for every changed existing output. Validate all original inputs and old recipes before authoring. Without a prior generation, retain immutable source identities and use the current pin as initial ancestry; with a valid same-pin generation, preserve its ancestry, purpose and reviews. Invalid existing generation metadata is never bypassed. This is not blanket same-commit capture.
resourceProbing: Match the trusted import scanner's regular-file-or-directory existence semantics for static URL resources, preserving target spelling including trailing slashes. Probe contained paths without reading directory bytes; reject symlinks, nonregular targets and outside-root traversal. Directory locations are references, never permission to copy their contents, and missing ordinary imports remain closure blockers.
artifactIdentity: After all fixed full commands succeed, trusted verifyArtifacts reads the version-1 .upstream-sync/verification-output/t3-artifact/artifact-manifest.json and its actual licenses/provenance/vendor/t3code JSON. Require target pin agreement, both source identities, exact candidate-generation bytes and matching artifact file records. Missing, stale or mismatched output cannot become full-passed. This data check does not execute artifact code or replace portable/native acceptance.
crossPinPackagingPrerequisite: The current shared packager stamps the old production pin. A future cross-pin full acceptance requires separate parent approval to derive that stamp from the verified source inventory and narrowly update its T3 host fingerprint, CC host fingerprint/local snapshot/patch registrations, and OpenHands host fingerprint. The PM-owned continuation pin also needs its separately reviewed host-boundary migration while retaining current Chat storage and default 409/session_mismatch behavior. Do not recapture unrelated dirty/shared files. Legacy fixed-pin replay guards affect optional sync/verify-sync, not the current fixed full command list.

selection.completePackages: Discover every tracked regular file, including new tests, exports, licenses, workers and resources, below ledger complete-package roots.
selection.selectedSources: Use ledger exact source/reference inputs, fixed client entrypoints, extraction and supplemental multi-input mappings. New dependencies outside complete packages require explicit scope review; never copy an entire application.
selection.dependencies: Regenerate scoped declarations, catalog uses, reachable lock snapshots and original/actual import-resource graphs. Preserve canonical npm-alias references and complete peer/patch snapshot suffixes for direct and transitive lock edges. Package self-references are valid only through the owning manifest exports and contained targets; missing exports and truly undeclared imports still block. Dependency/API/license/opaque resource changes require reviewed compatibility decisions; do not replace the PM lockfile or activate upstream application services.

adapterRequirements.reason: HostProcess.Environment is the authorized inheritance boundary; ambient process.env or external Home fallback would import unrelated credentials/state.
adapterRequirements.adapterInsufficiency: An outer wrapper cannot repair environment reads performed inside a provider or worker before its launch.
adapterRequirements.acceptance: Authorized native Provider Home/environment remains native; isolated instances and workers cannot inherit unapproved host credentials.
adapterRequirements.removalCondition: An equivalent upstream injectable environment boundary is integrated and isolation regression evidence passes.

adapterRequirements.reason: Native history/snapshot boundaries participate in the provider protocol and cannot be recreated by a lossy transport wrapper.
adapterRequirements.adapterInsufficiency: The required internal snapshot state is not available at an external wrapper boundary.
adapterRequirements.acceptance: History, cancellation and event errors preserve native semantics and PM scope/revision authorization.
adapterRequirements.removalCondition: Equivalent upstream protocol extensions and retained host behavior have explicit review and regression evidence.

adapterRequirements.reason: MCP connection failures must fail explicitly; isolated SDK/worker execution must not fall back to an ambient process or silently report success.
adapterRequirements.adapterInsufficiency: Connection/worker failure handling occurs inside the native adapter lifecycle.
adapterRequirements.acceptance: MCP refusal, worker failure and cancellation propagate; permissions, approvals and receipts stay PM-owned.
adapterRequirements.removalCondition: Upstream supplies equivalent injectable lifecycle/error boundaries with isolated worker/MCP regression evidence.

adapterRequirements.reason: Use host invalidation/configuration ports, not the upstream application session repository or a second database.
adapterRequirements.adapterInsufficiency: Restoring the original internal service dependencies bypasses PM ownership even when imports compile.
adapterRequirements.acceptance: PM authentication/audience, lease revisions and provider invalidation remain effective without foreign application services.
adapterRequirements.removalCondition: Equivalent upstream service injection is wired through the existing PM host and accepted behavior remains covered.

adapterRequirements.reason: Continuation records bind the upstream commit. An upgrade is not evidence of cross-version protocol compatibility.
adapterRequirements.adapterInsufficiency: Changing pins cannot migrate native provider state or existing Chat sidecars safely.
adapterRequirements.acceptance: Incompatible continuation remains 409/session_mismatch; never delete history, replay prompts automatically or replace current Chat persistence.
adapterRequirements.removalCondition: A separately reviewed compatible record/native-protocol conversion has concrete acceptance evidence.

review: Changed derived outputs require a decision covering every changed input, including non-primary inputs. Guarded adapters, package API/dependency and lock/resource/license changes require explicit reviewed source approval and reason. Deferred inputs block a global pin advance.
verification: Generation-aware trusted profile replay checks both pins and exact recipes. Legacy capture/sync guards remain unchanged and must never be relaxed to make an upgrade pass. Provenance is not build, packaging, native behavior or publish authorization.
